plan.title: Find live events by vendor participant

steps.note: Verify the Events list and its Create Event control rendered without an error.
Restrict the list to recent live events.
Open the first recent live event as the closest supported candidate event.
Open the event's Participants tab to inspect its invited vendors.
Search the participant list for the vendor name supplied at execution time.
Assert that the searched vendor is a participant in the selected live event.
